description: This is a Java test class for the VisitDAO component in the OpenMRS project, containing unit tests that verify the functionality of visit retrieval and management methods.

classes.name: VisitDAOTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest to verify algorithms related to visit data access within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Setup method that initializes the DAO object before each test execution.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldReturnAllUnvoidedVisitsIfIncludeEndedIsSetToTrue
methods.description: Test verifying that the DAO returns all unvoided visits when 'include ended' parameter is true.

methods.name: getVisits_shouldReturnOnlyActiveVisitsIfIncludeEndedIsSetToFalse
methods.description: Test verifying that the DAO returns only active (non-voided) visits when 'include ended' parameter is false.

methods.name: getNextVisit_shouldReturnTheNextUnvoidedActiveVisitMatchingTheSpecifiedTypesAndStartDate
methods.description: Test verifying the retrieval of the next relevant visit based on type and date filters.
